entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this piece of junk you sold me is completely broken! I want my money back immediately. This is unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. I can definitely look into this for you. To get started, could you please provide your name and order number?
The name is John Smith, order number is VF88602. Don't waste my time, just process the refund. The thing is not working at all.
Thank you, John. I have your account pulled up. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
Are you kidding me? It's a technical fault! The pulse reader is a joke and it won't sync with my phone anymore. This thing is defective! I want to speak to your manager right now.

I understand your frustration, and there's no need to speak to a manager; I can certainly help you with this. When a device won't sync, it sometimes points to a software issue our technical support team can resolve very quickly. If you'd like, I can transfer...

NO! I'm not getting transferred! I don't want it fixed, I want my money back. If you don't process a return for this broken product right now, I swear I'll post a review on every website telling people how VeloFit sells junk and has horrible service!
Okay, I understand. Let's skip the troubleshooting. I can definitely check on the return eligibility for you. Please give me just one moment to review the policy for your order.
Fine. But you'd better not come back with some excuse.

Alright, thank you for holding. I've pulled up your delivery date and our internal return guidelines. I see you received the item 25 days ago. Our policy states that you have 90 days from the date of delivery for a return. You're well within that window.
So you're processing the refund? No more games?

That's correct. Since the item is defective and you're within the 90-day period, I am approving a full refund. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label and sending it to the email address on file right now. Do you see it?
Let me check... yeah, I just got it. Okay. That's what you should have done from the start.

I apologize for the frustration. Once we receive the returned device, you'll see the refund credited back to your original payment method in 5 to 7 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, John?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
